title: What If You Saw the World in Slow Motion Like a Fly?
description:
A ball drifts toward you like a balloon. Someone swats at you and you have all the time in the world to step aside. A movie looks like a slideshow. Here's what life would be like if you saw the world as fast as a fly does: ceiling fan blades one by one, water breaking into droplets, fastballs you can read... and the most boring meetings of your life. Plus the experiment where scientists dropped volunteers off a tower to see if time really slows down.

Would you want to see the world in slow motion? Tell me in the comments 👇

▶ More What Ifs: What If You Could See Every Germ Around You?

SOURCES
• Flicker fusion: humans ~60 Hz, blowflies ~250 Hz
• Healy et al., Animal Behaviour 2013: smaller, faster animals perceive time faster
• Card & Dickinson 2008: fly escape manoeuvres
• Stetson, Fiesta & Eagleman, PLoS ONE 2007: falling does not speed up perception
